body:
A more powerful, personalized, and reliable Muslims Day experience.

✨ New Features

  • A Completely Redesigned Tasbeeh
    Enjoy a new Tasbeeh experience with an easier way to choose and use your favorite dhikr.

  • Create Your Own Dhikr
    Create and save custom dhikr and keep track of your Tasbeeh history.

  • New Location Setup Experience
    Set your location faster with a simplified GPS-first experience, or manually choose your city when needed.

  • New Birmingham Prayer Calculation Method
    Added a dedicated calculation method for more accurate prayer times in Birmingham, UK.

  • Forbidden-Time Salat Reminders
    Get reminders for times when offering voluntary prayers is discouraged.

  • Durood & Istighfar Reminders
    Receive gentle reminders with soft vibration and silent audio to help you maintain your daily dhikr.

⚡ Improvements

  • More Accurate Prayer Times
    Improved prayer-time accuracy for users in high-latitude European regions.

  • Smaller Android App Size
    Reduced the Android app size for a lighter installation.

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Fixed crashes when selecting text on older Android devices.

  • Fixed an issue where reminders could incorrectly show minutes as hours.

  • Fixed stacked prayer reminders on Android.

  • Fixed the city search box becoming unresponsive when the screen was locked.

  • Fixed battery-saver related prompts on Samsung devices.

Update to Muslims Day 6.3.0 and enjoy a better everyday experience.

Muslims Day July 2026 Release Summary

In July 2026 we have released two major features and few improvements.

New Features

  1. Ruqyah text & Audio feature added

  2. Istigfar reminder feature added

Improvements

  1. Improved Amal Tracker with a new History view

  2. UI Improvements

  3. Various bug fixes and stability improvements
